name: apple-platform-build
description: Build, test, and verify iOS/macOS/watchOS/tvOS/visionOS projects through Xcode's own MCP server (xcrun mcpbridge), falling back to xcodebuild when Xcode is not running. Includes simulator-verify, which drives an app in the iOS Simulator to check flows, crashes, logs and layout, the apvt skill, which finds layout mistakes in a running simulator app, and iphone-duo, which folds, unfolds, rotates and screenshots the foldable iPhone Duo simulator.
